# INW Basecamp — Northern Idaho Real Estate & Relocation

> Shirin Abplanalp helps active families relocate, root down, and thrive in one of the most beautiful places in America.

INW Basecamp is a Northern Idaho real estate and relocation resource built around Shirin Abplanalp, a licensed realtor with eXp Realty based in Post Falls, Idaho. Shirin relocated to Northern Idaho herself — giving her firsthand knowledge of what it takes to make the move from coastal and urban markets.

The site serves active families, remote workers, and outdoor enthusiasts considering relocation to the Inland Northwest, specifically the Coeur d'Alene, Post Falls, Rathdrum, and Sandpoint areas of Kootenai County.

## Who Shirin Serves

- Active families relocating from California, Washington, Oregon, and Texas
- Remote workers seeking outdoor lifestyle with fiber internet connectivity
- Buyers looking for acreage, rural properties, and custom home sites
- Outdoor enthusiasts seeking proximity to skiing, mountain biking, lake access, and trail systems

## The 60-Minute Rule

Northern Idaho's defining geographic advantage: lakes, ski resorts, mountain bike trails, and river rapids — all within 60 minutes of your front door. From Coeur d'Alene or Post Falls, you can be carving powder at Schweitzer, paddling on Priest Lake, or riding singletrack on Canfield Mountain — all before dinner.
